tools.name: keepasshelper-credential-request
tools.description: Request username and/or password credentials from the user for a specific website or service

href.description: The target website URL or domain or a query for which credentials are needed (e.g., 'github.com', 'https://example.com', 'my stored credential')

instruction.description: User-facing instructions describing what credentials are needed and why

outputSchema.description: Array of one or more command objects or error objects returned from the credential request

oneOf.description: Command object for inserting credentials into the page

cmd.description: Command identifier for the insert action

type.description: Type of credential data being inserted

value.description: The credential value (username, password, or field data). Required for 'username', 'password', and 'stringFields' types. Optional for 'submit' type.

oneOf.description: Error object if the credential request failed

type.description: Indicates this is an error object

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong
